dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Arlo was first surrendered to the care centers as a stray in February 2026, and was returned by his adopter in October 2026 due to behavioral concerns and not having enough time to care for him. His previous owner describes Arlo as a friendly, outgoing, playful dog who loves squeaky toys, and he has shown social behavior with staff while at the care center. Arlo is reported to have bitten twice in the home, when an unfamiliar person reached for him while he was being held; one of these bites broke skin, leaving a small puncture. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement with a New Hope placement partner who is able to provide an experienced adult-only foster home, a period of decompression, and evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
